## Use Mononoki in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Mononoki for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Mononoki', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Mononoki coding font

A lightweight programming font. Mononoki is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Mononoki is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Mononoki FAQ

### Is Mononoki free?

Yes. Mononoki is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Mononoki support ligatures?

No. Mononoki has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Mononoki?

Mononoki is available from GitHub. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
